caption: The drawing depicts a lantern-like object with a cylindrical top and base constructed from a dark brown material. The lantern frame forms an oval shape with two vertical, curved supports on each side, and it has a clear or light-grey glass section in the center. Inside this central space, there is a tall, transparent glass chimney that is part of an oil lamp situated at the bottom. To the left of the chimney, inside the lantern, there is a spherical object that is colored in shades of red and pink with some reflective highlights, giving it a shiny appearance. The drawing is done on an off-white background that is mostly blank except for the main object, and the lines and shading suggest the use of colored pencils or watercolors.
title: Kerosene Street Car Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
